snippet.title: Firefighting Simulator: Ignite - Exclusive Trailer - FGS Live From gamescom
snippet.description:
An exclusive new trailer for Firefighting Simulator: Ignite, where players can save lives from unpredictable dangers with up to 3 friends or the help of their NPC crew. Firefighting Simulator: Ignite is coming to PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on September 9th, 2025.

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS #firefightingsimulator
